symbols.description: A plate boundary where plates move apart and new crust is created.
symbols.name: divergent boundary

symbols.description: A region where plates move apart and crust is formed by rising magma.
symbols.name: spreading center

symbols.description: A large section of Earth's crust involved in movement at plate boundaries.
symbols.name: plate

symbols.description: Crust created as magma rises at a spreading center.
symbols.name: new crust

symbols.description: Crust transported away from a ridge crest by spreading.
symbols.name: oceanic crust

symbols.description: Molten material that rises from the mantle, pushes upward, and may erupt through cracks.
symbols.name: magma

symbols.description: Earth layer from which magma rises beneath spreading centers.
symbols.name: mantle

symbols.description: The crest of a ridge from which newly formed oceanic crust moves away.
symbols.name: ridge crest

symbols.description: The process by which newly formed oceanic crust moves away from a spreading ridge.
symbols.name: seafloor spreading

symbols.description: Movement of tectonic plates, including movement away from spreading centers.
symbols.name: plate movement

symbols.description: A submerged mountain range and segment of the global mid-ocean ridge system extending from the Arctic Ocean beyond southern Africa.
symbols.name: Mid-Atlantic Ridge

symbols.description: A global system of mid-ocean ridges encircling Earth.
symbols.name: global mid-ocean ridge system

symbols.description: The rate at which spreading occurs along a spreading center, expressed in centimeters per year or kilometers per million years.
symbols.name: spreading rate

symbols.description: The ocean that grew through seafloor spreading between Europe, Africa, and the Americas.
symbols.name: Atlantic Ocean

symbols.description: A continent bordering the Atlantic Ocean in the source description.
symbols.name: Europe

symbols.description: A continent bordering the Atlantic Ocean and containing the East African Rift Zone.
symbols.name: Africa

symbols.description: The continents bordering the Atlantic Ocean in the source description.
symbols.name: Americas

symbols.description: A volcanic country that straddles the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and exposes spreading processes on land.
symbols.name: Iceland

symbols.description: A plate on one side of the spreading center through Iceland.
symbols.name: North American Plate

symbols.description: A plate on the other side of the spreading center through Iceland.
symbols.name: Eurasian Plate

symbols.description: A volcano in northeastern Iceland around which effects of plate movement are visible.
symbols.name: Krafla Volcano

symbols.description: A crack in the ground that may widen or newly appear around the Krafla fissure zone.
symbols.name: ground crack

symbols.description: A zone along which repeated episodes of surface cracking occurred from 1975 to 1984.
symbols.name: Krafla fissure zone

symbols.description: Surface cracking associated with spreading and plate movement.
symbols.name: rifting

symbols.description: An episode of rifting occurring along the Krafla fissure zone.
symbols.name: rifting event

symbols.description: Volcanic activity accompanying some rifting events.
symbols.name: volcanic activity

symbols.description: Movement of the ground caused by rifting.
symbols.name: ground displacement

symbols.description: An event in which magma erupts through widening cracks and may form volcanoes.
symbols.name: eruption

symbols.description: A sea formed as spreading processes tore Saudi Arabia away from the rest of Africa.
symbols.name: Red Sea

symbols.description: Landmass described as having been torn away from the rest of the African continent by spreading.
symbols.name: Saudi Arabia

symbols.description: A plate that meets the African Plate at the triple junction where the Red Sea meets the Gulf of Aden.
symbols.name: Arabian Plate

symbols.description: A plate described as actively splitting and meeting the Arabian Plate at a triple junction.
symbols.name: African Plate

symbols.description: A body of water meeting the Red Sea at a triple junction.
symbols.name: Gulf of Aden

symbols.description: A junction where the African Plate and Arabian Plate meet in the region where the Red Sea meets the Gulf of Aden.
symbols.name: triple junction

symbols.description: A rift zone in Africa where a new spreading center may be developing.
symbols.name: East African Rift Zone

symbols.description: Crust that can stretch beyond its limits during spreading processes.
symbols.name: continental crust

symbols.description: A crack that appears on Earth's surface when continental crust stretches beyond its limits.
symbols.name: tension crack

symbols.description: A crack produced in the crust by rising magma and pressure.
symbols.name: fracture

symbols.description: A volcanic landform that can form when magma erupts through widening cracks.
symbols.name: volcano

symbols.description: A zone ultimately produced by crustal stretching, fractures, and spreading.
symbols.name: rift zone

symbols.description: The planet encircled by the global mid-ocean ridge system and containing the described crust and mantle.
symbols.name: Earth
